Hi Anita —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our exec-level discussion and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of pain / context
- Current GenAI proof-of-concept (NLP extraction + document summarization) is hitting unpredictable latency and cost spikes during peak batch runs.
- Regulatory/data residency constraints for certain trial datasets require VPC or private deployment options.
- Procurement wants clear information on SOC 2, data retention, and audit logging before moving forward.

Business goals (what success looks like)
- 40–60% reduction in inference unit cost for production workloads while keeping 95th percentile latency under 300ms for single-turn requests.
- Ability to host sensitive trial documents in a VPC with customer-managed keys.
- Rollout plan: pilot (Q4) -> production (Q1).

Key risks / escalation items
- Security/compliance review (SOC2 evidence + architecture diagram) — procurement will require these before contracting.
- Model performance regression — need run-of-workload evals and a rollback/fallback plan.

Procurement path / timeline (as discussed)
- Anita to confirm executive sponsor (you) and introduce procurement lead (Daniel) — target: procurement review week of Nov 16.
- Target contract close: before Jan 15 to align with Q1 pilot budget.

Agreed next steps
1) I’m sharing a short post-call deck, SOC2 checklist, and a mutual action plan (attached).
2) Can you introduce Daniel (or your procurement contact) and suggest 30 minutes next week for a procurement-specific call? (Suggested times: Wed 11/11 10–11am PT or Thu 11/12 1–3pm PT)
3) Aditya will share a short technical note on our private deployment options and KV caching approach for long-context workloads.

Attachments included: postcall-deck.pdf, SOC2-request.xlsx, mutual_action_plan.docx

If that all looks right I’ll draft a lightweight MSA redline and pricing options for the procurement call.

Thanks — look forward to next steps.

Best,
